HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Apis]
Waterbrash. θ Gastric catarrh.
Heartburn, five or ten minutes after the sting.
Heartburn extending up into throat. θ Pregnancy.
Eructations, with taste of ingesta ; increased after drinking water.
Bitter or acrid belching. θ Chronic gastritis.
Eructations, with flow of water into mouth.
Nausea, with inclination to vomit.
Disgust, nausea, with vertigo, faintness, sinking of strength till it comes to vomiting, with headache ; swelling of head, pains in stomach and diarrhœa.
With nausea and vertigo, general distress and prostration, with mental anxiety.
Nausea, retching and vomiting. θ Meningitis infantum.
Chronic gastritis.
Sickness at stomach, and pain over whole body so severe as to occasion crying.
Desire to vomit. θ Meningitis infantum. θ Catarrh of chest.
Vomiting.
Vomiting of ingesta and mucus. θ Acute Bright's disease.
Vomiting of frothy mucus during day ; after sudden nausea felt in throat. θ Ovarian tumor.
Vomiting of mucus, with red specks. θ Albuminuria.
Vomiting of slime and ingesta without loss of appetite. θ Acute Bright's disease.
Bitter vomit.
Nausea and vomiting of bile. θ Organic disease of heart.
Vomiting of bile ; of ingesta and slime. θ Gastric catarrh. θ Morbus Brightii.
Vomiting of bile. θ Catarrh of stomach.
Vomiting, with inflammation of stomach.
Vomiting in beginning of gastro-enteritis.
Vomiting, extreme pain and tenderness in region of stomach and upper abdomen. θ Gastro-enteritis.
Vomiting, with diarrhœa.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Apis]
Pit of stomach sensitive ; burning as from acidity ; irritability of stomach ; fulness ; pressure aggravates pains. θ Gastric catarrh.
Sensitiveness of pit of stomach to touch. θ Gastritis. θ Gastralgia.
Great soreness when touched in pit of stomach, under ribs, in abdomen.
Pit of stomach sensitive to pressure, and burning therein. θ Pregnancy.
Burning in pit of stomach. θ Gastritis.
Pressure in pit of stomach.
Pain and tenderness in epigastrium. θ Erysipelas.
Sensation of burning in epigastrium like from acidity in stomach. θ Erysipelas.
Excessive pain and tenderness of stomach region and epigastrium. θ Gastro-enteritis.
Weak, faint sensation in epigastrium, with loss of appetite. θ Ovarian tumor.
Pain in cardiac region, shooting, obstructing breath.
Sensitiveness, fulness and burning in stomach, with catarrh of throat.
Irritability of stomach. θ Chronic catarrh of stomach.
Sensation of soreness in stomach and abdomen.
Sensitiveness and burning of bowels ; < on pressure. θ Chronic gastritis.
Burning in stomach after erysipelas.
Burning heat in stomach.
Violent pain and sensitiveness in region of stomach.
Extreme pain and tenderness in region of stomach and upper abdomen, with vomiting. θ Gastro-enteritis.
Sharp, crampy pains in stomach and abdomen, followed by vomiting and diarrhœa at intervals, lasts two hours.
Gastralgia. θ Bilious diarrhœa.
Irritation of digestive organs, with hot or burning sensations. θ Dyspepsia.
Aching and pressure in stomach ; pricking, sore feeling, burning and great tenderness.
Distension of stomach, with burning in epigastrium.
Erysipelas of stomach and bowels.
Contusions of stomach and bowels.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Apis]
Pressure against diaphragm renders respiration laborious. θ Ascites.
Soreness at insertion of diaphragm and in back. θ Cholerine.
Inflammation of diaphragm.
Under right ribs, sensation as if "gone to sleep."
Hyperemic state of liver. θ Organic disease of heart.
Inflammation of spleen.
Considerable swelling of spleen, abdomen sunken in. θ Typhus.
Pain left side, under short ribs and in mediastinum. θ Chest complaint.
Pain under short ribs ; < left side. θ Intermittent, apyrexia.
Soreness and bruised feeling, as after a contusion, most about last ribs, left side.
Severe burning pain under short ribs, on both sides ; most severe on left, continuing there for weeks, depriving her of sleep.
Pains from below ribs, spreading upward.
Obliged to bend forward from a painful contractive feeling in hypochondria.
Tension over hypochondria, with pricking sensation.
Clothes could no longer be made to meet around his waist. θ Ascites.
Sensation of soreness or burning under ribs.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Apis]
Abdomen contracted.
Heavy painful pressure, violent contraction, compression and urging in belly.
Collapse of abdominal walls. θ Meningitis infantum.
Heaviness in abdomen. θ Menorrhagia. θ Metrorrhagia.
Bearing down pain, with tenderness of ovarian region. θ Prolapsus uteri.
Numbness in right side of abdomen.
Sick feeling in abdomen, inclining to sit quiet.
Burning, stinging in abdomen ; sore to touch. θ Peritonitis.
Soreness of bowels felt when sneezing or pressing on them.
Feeling as if intestines were bruised. θ Dysentery. θ Ascites.
Feeling in belly as if something tight would break if too much effort were made at stool. θ Pregnancy.
Erysipelas from contusions in stomach and bowels.
Sore pains in bowels. θ Enteritis.
Soreness and burning pain in abdomen. θ Bilious diarrhœa.
Great pain in abdomen. θ Acute Bright's disease.
Aching at umbilicus, < in morning. θ Albuminuria.
Violent cutting pains in abdomen. θ Morbus Brightii.
Severe griping pains in bowels.
Violent pains in belly when lying ; > sitting up.
Pains in abdomen when walking.
Bellyache with call to stool in morning.
Inflammation of bowels. θ Ascites.
Peritonitis with exudation ; often with metritis ; urine scanty, dark.
Soreness of bowels, felt when pressing upon them, or sneezing. θ Ascites.
General soreness of abdomen. θ Chronic dysentery.
Abdomen sore to touch. θ Eruptive disease. θ Scarlatina.
Burning in abdomen and tenderness to least pressure.
Fulness and tenderness of abdomen. θ Ascites.
Abdomen very tender to touch, even to pressure of bedclothes. θ Ascites.
Tenderness of entire peritoneum on pressure or on turning in bed.
When pressed on right side of abdomen she makes a wry face. θ Typhus.
Tenderness of abdomen on pressure. θ Enteritis. θ Diarrhœa. θ Dysentery. θ Typhus.
Burning, internal soreness, with external tenderness, even to pressure of bedclothes.
Great soreness of abdominal walls. θ Ascites.
Cutting pain in abdominal walls.
On pressing on ileo-cecal region a gurgling like from a fluid is heard. θ Typhus.
Rolling and rumbling of wind in bowels, with diarrhœa. θ Typhus.
Rumbling in abdomen. θ Flatulency. θ Typhus. θ Enteritis. θ Chronic dysentery.
Great soreness and bloatedness in abdomen, as if she was inflated.
Meteoritic distension. θ Typhus.
Fulness and enlargement of abdomen. θ Ascites.
Sensation of fulness in abdomen, with dull pains, < on motion and from pressure.
Sense of fulness in bowels. θ Bilious diarrhœa.
Abdomen full, swollen and tender, with swollen feet and scanty secretion of urine.
Sense of fulness and tightness of bowels. θ Enteritis.
Belly feels full and hard. θ Dropsy after scarlatina.
Swelling of abdomen without thirst. θ Ascites.
Swelling of abdomen and limbs. θ Organic disease of heart.
Abdomen very much distended by fluid. θ Ascites. θ Albuminuria. θ Dropsy after scarlatina.
Circumference of abdomen increased in one day by three-fourths of an inch. θ Ascites.
Abdomen begins to swell, with much difficulty, of breathing, especially after going up-stairs quickly. θ Amenorrhœa.
Walls of abdomen tense. θ Typhus.
Ascites and anasarca.
Enlargement of abdomen. θ Intermittent, apyrexia.
Ascites with vomiting and diarrhœa ; can't get breath except when sitting ; even leaning backward causes suffocation ; urine scant, dark, like coffee-grounds.
Ascites : from albuminuria ; post-scarlatinal or with uterine tumors ; after peritonitis.
Pain extending into thigh or upward to ribs. θ Ovaritis.
Aching, pressive pain in hypogastrium, with bearing down in uterus.
Slow throbbing boring pain over left iliac crest, relieved by eructations.
Sensitiveness of ileo-cecal region. θ Typhus.
Severe aching in loins. θ Ovarian tumor.
Neuralgia in groins.
Swelling in right groin oblong, hard, large as a cucumber.
Hard swelling in right groin.
A large swelling in left inguinal region. θ Syphilis.
Long-standing inguinal hernia.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Apis]
Throbbing in rectum.
Electric shock in rectum before urging to stool.
Tenesmus. θ Diphtheria. θ Ascites.
Feeling of approaching diarrhœa, urging pressing and tenesmus in bowels.
Tenesmus, bowels feel bruised. θ Dysentery. θ Prolapsus ani.
Repeated inclination to have a discharge from bowels. θ Organic disease of heart.
Passage of flatus before stool.
Distended and sore bowels with much flatulence and small alvine discharges affording no relief.
Tendency to diarrhœa. θ Enteritis.
Painless morning diarrhœa.
Diarrhœa (with the exception of dysentery) predominantly painless.
A painless diarrhœa appears before relief of chest complaint.
Painless diarrhœa, greenish-yellow.
Painless yellow diarrhœa. θ Gastritis.
Looseness of bowels in morning, thin, watery, yellowish discharges, generally painless, only at times griping.
Yellowish motions with a tinge of green with scarcely any pain. θ Erysipelas in stomach.
Painless diarrhœa, yellowish, sometimes greenish and slimy. θ Bronchitis.

Frequent painless bloody stools. θ Dysentery of infants.
Watery diarrhœa. θ Catarrh of stomach.
Watery, frequent, copious, almost black motions.
Watery diarrhœa, with smarting at anus.
Stools : watery ; yellow, watery, with griping ; watery and foul smelling ; watery, copious, black ; thin yellow with extreme weakness ; greenish-yellowish mucus ; < mornings, slimy, mucus and blood ; frequent, bloody, painless, olive green, slimy, profuse ; full of bright red lumps.
Stools yellowish, greenish, with some bellyache. θ Diarrhœa. θ Catarrh of stomach.
Yellow brown stools, with frequent painful urination.
Several thin, yellow stools with extreme weakness and prostration ; stools occur with every motion of body, as if anus was constantly open.
Evacuation of mucus with pain, as if bowels were squeezed to pieces.
Excessive mucous secretions. θ Enteritis.
Slimy stools. θ Catarrh of stomach.

Copious evacuations of blackish-brown, green and whitish excrements.
Stools soft and pappy, mixed with serum, as if soft feces had been beaten in water, but not dissolved, orange-colored.
Frequent discharge of gelatinous mucus with slight tenesmus. θ Chronic dysentery.
Brownish, watery or bloody discharges. θ Typhus.
Loose stools containing some mucus and considerable blood.
Frequent, bloody, painless ; infantile dysentery ; sometimes only tenesmus with bruised feeling in bowels.
Small dark stools smelling brassy. θ Incipient hydrocephalus.
Fetid diarrhœa, then tenesmus, with passages of blood.
Stools watery, foul smelling.
Stools smelling very offensive. θ Typhus.
Every day six or eight diarrheic discharges of a smell like carrion. θ Typhus.
Frequent, loose, painful, putrid, bloody involuntary discharges. θ Typhus.
Diarrhœa in morning or forenoon, returning at same hour.
Diarrhœa in morning for three or four weeks ; thin, watery, yellowish, only sometimes with griping.
Soft stool, every morning, light-colored.

Diarrhœa at night and following day, stool like oat grits. θ Typhus.
Erysipelatous stools (Schonlein). θ Catarrh of stomach.
Diarrhœa. θ Intermittent. θ Measles. θ After erysipelas.
Chronic diarrhœa of a bilious or erysipelatous character.
Chronic diarrhœa with many small passages of blood and mucus : woman at critical age.
Nausea, vomiting and diarrhœa, first lumpy and not fetid ; afterwards watery and very fetid ; then pappy, mixed with mucus and blood.
Diarrhœa only temporarily stopped by Arsen. θ Ovarian dropsy.
Before stool : straining ; passage of flatus.
During stool : straining, pinching, nausea, vomiting, frontal headache, backache.
Intestinal catarrh, with slimy diarrhœa and muttering delirium. θ Eruptive diseases.
Increasing prostration during diarrhœa.
Diarrhœa and vomiting.
Hemorrhage from bowels, with burning pains, excoriation of anus, constant tenesmus. θ Prolapsus ani.
After stool : faint, exhausted ; tenesmus, discharge of blood ; burning at anus (typhus) ; anus feels raw.
Dysentery.
Frequent disposition to go to stool, with inability to accomplish anything.
Hard, regular stools, during menstruation.
Slight constipation. θ Incipient hydrocephalus.
Stools seldom and very difficult, with stinging pains. θ Pregnancy.
Hard and costive motions. θ Erysipelas.

Chronic constipation.
Constipation. θ Sopor. θ Cerebro-spinal meningitis. θ Meningitis infantum. θ Gastro-enteritis. θ Hemorrhoids. θ Prostatic affections. θ Organic disease of heart. θ Typhus. θ Abscess after vaccination.
Feeling in anus as if it was stuffed full, with heat and throbbing in rectum.
Sensation of rawness in anus with diarrhœa.
Small bilious discharges, producing slight smarting at anus and tenesmus.
Intolerable itching with swelling in anus.
Whitish-red swelling of anus with intolerable itching ; child, æt. 15 months.
Stinging in anus and rectum, followed by fever, burning. θ Hemorrhoids.
Bloody exudation with swelling of anus.
Prolapsus ani with hemorrhage from bowels, with burning pain, excoriation of anus and constant tenesmus.
Stool with every motion of body, as if anus was constantly open.

Much stinging pain in anus, constipation and scanty urine.

Intolerable, shooting, burning pains in hemorrhoidal tumors.
Piles with stinging ; protruding, small ; burn and smart intolerably.
